summary.text: William Moskal is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 80, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Adam Botana.
Moskal, who holds a Ph.D. and works as a healthcare consultant, says he is running on managing growth, affordability and insurance reform.

paragraphs.text: William Moskal graduated from Immaculate Conception High School and earned a Ph.D. from Wayne State University in 1978, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes working as a healthcare consultant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a teacher, healthcare executive and consultant with more than 40 years of experience.

Moskal's survey responses name managing growth so that roads, schools, water systems and storm protection keep pace with development, and making District 80 more affordable through homeowners insurance reform and more housing for working families and teachers, as key campaign messages.
He said he is also passionate about giving voters a voice, clean water and responsible planning.
